text:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] Progressive rollout started for release v3.0.0 -> staging (rollout id r-2026-03-20-01). Target traffic: 20%. Starting now. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/r-2026-03-20-01. @alice.release please confirm go/no-go for the canary within 10m.

alice.release: Kicking off canary checks. ETA ~3m. Tagging oncall and QA.

bob-oncall: I'm seeing a small spike in 5xx on /v1/generate around the canary window. p99 errors ~1.2% vs baseline 0.1%.
Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T01:07:12Z] svc-gen us-west-2a code=500 msg="model_infer_failed" model=v3.0.0 req_id=abcd1234
[2026-03-20T01:07:13Z] svc-gen us-west-2a code=500 msg="kv_cache_miss" model=v3.0.0 req_id=abcd1235
```

carla-ml: Quick note: v3.0.0 was quantized with int8 prod profile. Preliminary eval on held set shows structural token errors higher than v2 (12.3% vs 3.1%). Could be quantization regression or cache warm effects. Recommend pausing at 20% while we triage.

darrin-enginfra: No OOMs or node churn. GPU pool usage steady. However us-west-2a p95 latency doubled (420ms vs usual 210ms). Routing heatmap shows most canary traffic pinned to a small subset of pods — possible shard hotspot.

frank-qa: Reproduced structured-output mismatch for the invoice-parser prompt. v3 sometimes drops the "line_items" array entirely.
Failing prompt (sanitized): `parse_invoice("INV-2026-1023")` -> missing fields on ~4/20 samples.

eva-product: Low customer-facing errors so far but the invoice-parser integration is used by a few enterprise trials. We should be conservative.

alice.release: Decision: PAUSE progressive rollout at current 20% (hold). We will pin the /invoice-parser route back to v2.1.4 for now and pause the rollout id r-2026-03-20-01. Action owners: @carla-ml triage quantization, @frank-qa repro & expand test coverage, @darrin-enginfra check routing hotspot.

alice.release: Commanding deploy-bot: `@deploy-bot pause-rollout r-2026-03-20-01 && pin-route /invoice-parser v2.1.4`

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Executing commands...
- pause_rollout r-2026-03-20-01 -> OK
- pin route /invoice-parser -> v2.1.4 (pin id p-3345) -> OK
Rollout status: PAUSED. Notes: Traffic for other routes unaffected. Audit: https://console.redwood.ai/audit/r-2026-03-20-01

gina-englead: Good catch. Please open a follow-up ticket for regression tracking and a postmortem. Tagging @carla-ml and @frank-qa for ownership.

alice.release: Created ticket RN-2321 (regression: v3 quantization) and PM task PROD-578 assigned to carla-ml. Also added short-term mitigation steps to release notes.

bob-oncall: I'll continue to monitor. Metrics trending back to baseline after the pin. Will watch for 2h and report any recurrences.

carla-ml: I'll start by running eval suite with the pre/ post-quant configs and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/r-2026-03-20-01. Initial hypothesis: quantization config drift between staging build and prod optimizer flags.

frank-qa: I'll add failing prompts to the regression harness and push test vectors to the shared repo. Will update RN-2321 with repro paths.

alice.release: Thanks everyone. We kept rollout contained. We'll re-run a controlled canary once Carla has fixes and QA signs off. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Thread closed by action. If you need to resume: `/deploy resume r-2026-03-20-01 --percent 5` (manual approval required).
